metadata.label: Shape model
metadata.coverage: Published PDS shape model, including poorly constrained source estimates. The constraint lens uses gray for stereo control, blue for limb silhouettes, and ochre for poorly constrained terrain. These are evidence categories, not surface colors. The combined model pole is retained at RA 255°, Dec +64.5°. Rotational phase is arbitrary and held fixed; no encounter or current rotation reconstruction is claimed.
